violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2026

Pork, which was prepared last night, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Pork observed with a temperature of 48 degrees F. Voluntary disposal during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2026

Pan of pork and pan of beans observed held at 132 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were reheated to a temperature of 175 degrees F and were returned to hot hold unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2026

Pork was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Voluntary disposal during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2026
Potatoes were observed stored on the ground. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
